gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of malignant glioma (defined as WHO grade III or IV) with previous RT to tumour
Gliomas with Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild-type status, as defined on immunohistochemistry

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is not named literally; eligibility combines WHO grade III or IV malignant glioma with IDH-wildtype, which includes IDH-wildtype grade 4 glioma (=GBM) but could be read as high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] FET PET: There is only one study visit during which study subjects will undergo a 18F-FET PET/CT in SGH.
Performance characteristics of FET PET in differentiating pseudoprogression from tumour progression in patients with equivocal conventional imaging

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: With enlarging contrast-enhancing and/or T2W/FLAIR-hyperintense lesion(s) on MRI within the previous RT field

role_evidence.quote: The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate the performance characteristics of O-(2-\[18F\]fluoroethyl)-L-tyrosine (FET) PET in differentiating pseudoprogression from tumour progression

source_quote.quote: Gliomas with Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild-type status, as defined on immunohistochemistry

coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging study (18F-FET PET to distinguish pseudoprogression from progression); intervention registered as Diagnostic Test; the only agent is the PET tracer, so no pharmacological candidate. Population: WHO grade III or IV malignant glioma, IDH-wildtype, previously irradiated, with enlarging lesions; glioblastoma not named literally. Treatment setting unclear: patients have post-RT enlarging lesions that may be progression or pseudoprogression (not a treatment trial). IDH-wildtype is an entry requirement used to define the population; never candidate-matched.
